notes.title: DBC17 Demo - Release 0.0.78 Live Now
notes.notes:
New update is now live.
 
This adds a new feature – BAT MANAGER

The Bat Manager allows you to place logos on a bat and then assign that bat to Multiple players.

Any changes you then make to that bat in the Bat Manager will carry through to ALL players that have been assigned the bat.

We have also fixed up the majority of anomalies within the Stadium Creator that occurred after the previous Academy update – unfortunately some existing stadia  will have data that is incompatible with the Stadium Creator going forward – you may find that some Props are incorrect in levels (items such as hills appearing that were fences, etc.) or in the worst case that the level has no content. 

We have worked long and hard to minimise the loss as much as possible however could not remedy all, if you are one of the people effected we offer our sincere apologies.

notes.title: DBC17 Demo - Release 0.0.75 Live Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Our weekly update is early! A new update is now live.

Update notes are as follows:

BOWLING MINI-GAME
A new bowling mini-game now available in training mode.

Scoring system as below:
10 points for hitting the yellow pitch marker
25 points for hitting the blue pitch marker
50 points for hitting the green pitch marker

1 points towards multiplier for hitting the ring of the vertical marker
3 points towards multiplier for hitting inside the ring of the vertical marker

The streak will reset if you miss both markers.

ACADEMY
Added Show Club Icon option for team uniforms

STADIUM CREATOR
Stability improvements to Stadium Creator

notes.title: DBC17 Demo - Release 0.0.67 Live Now
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have some big news of an update to share today, a new update for Steam just went live. There's a lot of updates to go through, so I've broken it down into several big points.

LOGO CREATOR
- Includes an SVG Importer.
- 3 Node tools for endless creation possibilities (Straight, Curve, Bezier).
- Overlay option - Import an image to trace over with nodes to help bring your creation to life.
- Colour, saturation and brightness swatches to select from over 16 million different colour options.
- Gradients - Linear or Radial Gradients with the ability to select different scales and start points.

TEAMS
- Create men's and women's teams.
- Create uniforms, manage squad, lineups, choose team logos, and colours.
- Add created logos to uniforms.
- Position, scale, rotate and flip logos to perfect what your uniforms look like.
- Add overlay function.

PLAYERS
- Makeup added for female players.
- Equipment tile opened for bat creation.
- 5 bat models to select from.
- Add created logos to bats.
- Position, scale, rotate and flip logos to perfect how your bat will look.
- General lighting, morph and texture improvements.
- Add overlay function.
